props.name: start
props.description: The first pane — left, or top when vertical.

props.name: end
props.description: The second pane. It takes whatever the first does not.

props.name: orientation
props.description: horizontal sets the panes side by side; vertical stacks them.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the first pane, as a percentage. Pass it to control the split.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Starting size when the component owns the split.

props.name: onSizeChange
props.description: Fires on each keyboard step, and once when a drag ends.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest the first pane may be, as a percentage.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest the first pane may be, as a percentage.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the divider — say what it resizes.
